target_customer: Local merchants, pharmacies and reseller networks in Nigeria that act as banking agents, plus the customers who use them for cash and payments
problem: Most Nigerians lived far from a bank branch and relied on cash, so access to deposits, withdrawals and transfers was poor.
business_model: Agency banking: transaction fees on payments and cash services through a distributed POS terminal and agent network

founders.name: Oluwatomi Ayorinde
founders.background_notes: YC page says he built a banking solution for microfinance banks in Nigeria. Later co-founded Timon, a stablecoin travel payments company.

founders.name: Damilola Ayorinde
founders.background_notes: No background found on the YC page.

competitors.name: Paga
competitors.what: Nigerian agent network and mobile payments

competitors.name: TeamApt (Moniepoint)
competitors.what: POS terminals and agent banking for merchants

competitors.name: OPay
competitors.what: Mobile money and POS agent network

technical_complexity.rationale: Core banking integration, POS terminal logistics and fraud controls across many agents is standard fintech engineering with operational difficulty, built on the founder's prior microfinance banking software.

defensibility.rationale: Agent networks can be replicated with capital; CrowdForce differed by distributing terminals through pharmacies and reseller networks but faced much larger rivals.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Rivals scaled to hundreds of thousands of agents by 2022 while CrowdForce's PayForce unit was acquired by FairMoney in March 2023.

market_need_then: Nigeria had a large unbanked population and heavy cash use. A 2020 EFInA agents survey and later coverage show strong agent demand; exact figures were not verified here.

branding.domain_note: crowdforce.io, not an exact .com; the site returned empty content when fetched.

identity.logo: Orange and white logo per the YC page

brand_strength.rationale: Press covered the funding and exit but no source shows a recognizable brand; the PayForce sub brand carried the merchant payments product.

outcome_analysis: CrowdForce built a merchant distribution network for agent banking in Nigeria, said it was cash positive from 2020 and raised a $3.6M pre Series A in February 2022 including $1M of debt. Facing much larger rivals like OPay and Moniepoint, its PayForce unit was sold to FairMoney in March 2023 and the CEO joined FairMoney, a modest exit that suggests a strategic sale rather than a breakout.
notes: The YC directory marks the company Acquired, but the deal covers the PayForce sub brand; whether all of CrowdForce was bought is not stated. TechCrunch sources put the price at 15 to 20 million dollars, an unverified figure not recorded in exit. CB Insights says founded 2018, YC says 2017. Competitor sources are dated 2021, not 2020, and give no traction numbers then. The Feb 2022 round is labelled pre Series A by most outlets and Series A by one.
